findings.governingReading: Shirou tentatively reconstructs the earlier question with “if I remember correctly.”
findings.explanation: The English begins as a direct recollection and removes his uncertainty about its exact form.

findings.highlight: If I’ll be able to fight until the very end
findings.evidenceJa: 何があっても、最後まで戦えるか
findings.governingReading: The remembered question asks whether Shirou can fight to the end no matter what happens.
findings.explanation: The English removes the unconditional “whatever happens” test of his resolve.

findings.highlight: I’ll fight Sakura to save her
findings.evidenceJa: 桜を取り戻す為に桜と戦う
findings.governingReading: Shirou will fight Sakura in order to reclaim or get Sakura back.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes generic rescue and loses his aim of recovering the Sakura he understands as displaced or taken over.

findings.highlight: I’ll do whatever it takes to kill you
findings.evidenceJa: 全力で排除するだけだ
findings.governingReading: If Rider obstructs him, Shirou says he will remove her with all his strength.
findings.explanation: The English makes killing Rider his explicit goal, hardening resolve into a lethal declaration absent from the source.
